path_primary_units.content: Routes application and stress-test material while explicitly denying application-level expansion or validation of the primary scientific claim.
Identifies current canonical materials and states that historical documents do not override the present claim boundary.
States that evaluation protocols are proposed tests unless a result document explicitly records execution and must not be treated as empirical support by default.
Persisted reader-calibration administration dry run; evaluator had extensive prior framework exposure, so the response is contaminated and does not count as blind reader evidence.
Routes historical material and explicitly states that preservation grants historical visibility, not current canonical authority.
Defines Pilot 0 as a feasibility/translation/usability package; no participant data have been collected and it is not benchmark v0.6 or completed comparative validation.
Plural adjudication template for preserving disagreement and underidentification; an empty template is not an adjudication result.
Template for recording participant, case, representation, translation and governance failures; contains no observed failure data.
Defines staged neutral cases intended to avoid framework-specific ontology leakage; cases are evaluation substrate, not evidence for the framework.
Native-first participant response instrument preserving unsupported-open status and method-native representation; contains no participant response data.
Draft predeclares Pilot 0 conditions, analyses and stop/narrow rules; it is not an independently registered study and human execution remains contingent on governance/ethics requirements.
Defines claim-contract and comparator representation manuals while preserving native-first responses before cross-method extraction; training material is not outcome evidence.
Defines multi-dimensional scoring including correction errors, open-status handling, disagreement legibility and complexity; scoring design does not validate the scored construct.
Tests whether mature methods can reproduce the claimed distinctions more naturally/cheaply; absorption into existing practice is an allowed successful correction outcome.
Validates repository-local links and Markdown/formatting invariants; it is not a scientific validator and produces no scientific authority by itself.

standing_split_units.content: A real administration procedure was attempted and persisted, so this is stronger than an unexecuted template but weaker than blind evaluation evidence.
Evaluator prior exposure and answer-key/context contamination prohibit treating the response as independent reconstruction evidence.
N_blind = 0; no independent-reader reliability or usability estimate may be imputed.
Participant data = NONE; Pilot 0 remains unexecuted as a human study.
Pilot materials can establish protocol completeness/readiness only, not usability, comparative advantage, external validity or framework effectiveness.
Current routing has interpretive precedence where historical wording conflicts, while historical state remains preserved rather than deleted.
Cross-domain application or stress-test coherence does not expand the primary claim's scientific scope or establish external validation.
